questions.question: Why do modern AI engineers use an end-to-end pipeline instead of writing all model math from scratch?
options: Because pre-trained models remove the need for data
Because the pipeline handles data preparation, model use, and output translation efficiently
Because AI models cannot be downloaded from the internet
Because transformers only work without code

questions.question: Which combination best represents the three main pillars of the HuggingFace ecosystem mentioned in the chapter?
options: Model Hub, Datasets Hub, Transformers Library
GPU Hub, Token Hub, API Hub
Encoder Hub, Decoder Hub, Loss Hub
Training Hub, Testing Hub, Deployment Hub

questions.question: The Model Hub on HuggingFace is best described as:
options: A library of training videos for programmers
A massive collection of pre-trained open-source AI models
A storage space for only private datasets
A tool used only for image editing

questions.question: The Datasets Hub is mainly used to store:
options: Only code files
Only trained weights
Text, image, and audio data used to train models
Only token IDs

questions.question: Why is the Transformers Library so important in the HuggingFace ecosystem?
options: It physically stores GPUs for users
It lets developers connect models and datasets with just a few lines of Python code
It automatically writes social media posts
It replaces all machine learning math with rules

questions.question: What does ETL stand for in the data pipeline?
options: Encode, Train, Load
Extract, Transform, Load
Evaluate, Test, Learn
Extract, Translate, Label

questions.question: In the ETL pipeline, which step involves collecting messy raw data from sources such as TikTok transcripts and Instagram captions?
options: Extract
Transform
Load
Decode

questions.question: What is the main purpose of the Transform step in ETL?
options: To make the data more messy so the model learns better
To clean, remove noise, and convert text into numbers
To store the data inside the model permanently
To generate final captions directly

questions.question: Why is a Tokenizer essential in the Transform step?
options: It converts English words into machine-readable numbers
It trains the model on the GPU
It predicts the final answer directly
It deletes punctuation only

questions.question: What does the Load step do in the ETL pipeline?
options: It converts numbers back into English
It feeds the cleaned numerical data into the GPU for learning
It downloads a new model from the internet
It removes the tokenizer vocabulary

questions.question: Why is tokenization model-specific in HuggingFace pipelines?
options: Because every model uses the same token IDs
Because different models may assign different IDs to the same word
Because tokenization only works for English
Because tokenizers do not need vocabularies

questions.question: What could happen if you use the wrong tokenizer with a model?
options: The AI will speak total gibberish or misread the input
The model will instantly become faster
The dataset will become larger
The GPU will turn into a CPU

questions.question: What is Encoding in the tokenization process?
options: Turning generated numbers back into readable text
Turning a prompt into a list of integer token IDs
Training the model on the dataset
Filtering out all punctuation permanently

questions.question: What is the role of an Attention Mask?
options: It tells the model which tokens are real and which are padding
It measures the accuracy of the model
It turns text into images
It stores the final answer of the model

questions.question: Why are attention masks useful in a tokenized input?
options: They help the model ignore empty padding spaces
They replace the tokenizer
They increase the vocabulary size
They make every token identical

questions.question: What does Decoding mean in the HuggingFace pipeline?
options: Converting model-generated numbers back into readable language
Breaking words into smaller pieces
Cleaning raw web data
Downloading the model weights

questions.question: In inference, what happens after the tokenizer converts the user input into numbers?
options: The numbers are loaded into the model for a forward pass
The model is deleted and replaced
The output is immediately shown without processing
The tokenizer creates a new vocabulary

questions.question: What is the technical meaning of inference in AI?
options: Training the model using labeled examples
Asking the AI a question and getting an answer
Cleaning only image data
Reducing the vocabulary size

questions.question: Which sequence correctly describes an end-to-end HuggingFace inference pipeline?
options: Download model and tokenizer → tokenize input → forward pass → decode output
Decode output → download model → tokenize input → train model
Load model → remove tokens → predict web search → encode output
Extract output → transform model → load prompt → decode dataset

questions.question: Why is HuggingFace especially valuable for applied AI development?
options: It eliminates the need for all programming
It gives developers access to pre-trained models, datasets, and reusable tools
It only supports one model type
It works only for social media apps
